cues.en: You know, I was pretty decent at math when I was in high school.
cues.zh: 你知道，高中時，我的數學還算不錯。

cues.en: Not great, but decent.
cues.zh: 不算非常好，但還不錯。

cues.en: I could do my homework right before it was due, and I never really had to study for exams.
cues.zh: 可以在截止之前才寫作業，也從來不太需要為考試特別讀書。

cues.en: But I also wasn't a math whiz.
cues.zh: 但我也不是數學天才。

cues.en: You know, my math teachers never singled me out for being good at math.
cues.zh: 數學老師從來不會特別指出，我數學很好。

cues.en: I was never encouraged to continue studying math.
cues.zh: 也從來沒有人鼓勵我繼續學數學。

cues.en: But yeah, also math at my high school just wasn't very difficult.
cues.zh: 不過，我高中時的數學，也真的沒有很難。

cues.en: So but then I went to university and at the beginning of my PhD, I thought I was terrible at math.
cues.zh: 後來上大學，在博士班剛開始時，我覺得自己的數學糟透了。

cues.en: I thought I just, you know, I didn't get it and I couldn't get it.
cues.zh: 我覺得自己就是不懂，而且不可能懂。

cues.en: And I wouldn't understand math, let alone teach it.
cues.zh: 我不會理解數學，更別說教數學。

cues.en: Crazy, right?
cues.zh: 很瘋狂，對吧？

cues.en: And why did I believe that?
cues.zh: 為什麼我會這樣相信？

cues.en: I believe that because I found math hard.
cues.zh: 因為我覺得數學很難。

cues.en: I didn't just get it immediately.
cues.zh: 不是一看就懂。

cues.en: I had to read books, watch YouTube videos, go through lots of exercises, work through the math in code.
cues.zh: 必須讀書、看 YouTube 影片、做很多練習，再用程式碼實作那些數學。

cues.en: And eventually I started to understand it.
cues.zh: 最後才開始理解。

cues.en: But I had this idea, you know, this really poisonous, really toxic idea that if I didn't understand
cues.zh: 但我心裡有個想法，一個非常有害、非常負面的想法：如果不能

cues.en: it immediately, then I wasn't smart enough to understand it.
cues.zh: 立刻理解，就表示我不夠聰明，沒能力理解。

cues.en: Now, unfortunately, that toxic thought, that is a pretty common thought and it's a major block for
cues.zh: 可惜，這種有害的想法相當常見，也是

cues.en: many people learning mathematics or learning anything difficult, really, whether it's technical or artistic or social.
cues.zh: 許多人學數學，或任何困難事物時的重大障礙，不管是技術、藝術，還是社交。

cues.en: The fact is that math is difficult for most people.
cues.zh: 事實是，對多數人而言，數學都很難。

cues.en: Sure, there are some people who are incredibly mathematically gifted and concepts come to them immediately and naturally.
cues.zh: 當然，有些人數學天分非常高，概念對他們而言自然而然，立刻就能掌握。

cues.en: But most of us have to work hard.
cues.zh: 但我們多數人，都必須努力。

cues.en: We have to work really hard to achieve understanding.
cues.zh: 必須非常努力，才能理解。

cues.en: Obviously, you're one of those people because.
cues.zh: 顯然，你也是這樣的人，因為，

cues.en: Well, because you're listening to this video.
cues.zh: 因為你正在聽這支影片。

cues.en: The point that I want to make is that math is hard.
cues.zh: 我想說的重點是，數學很難。

cues.en: And if you think that it's hard because you are not smart enough to learn it, that's wrong.
cues.zh: 如果你認為，它很難是因為自己不夠聰明、學不會，那就錯了。

cues.en: Math is hard because it's hard.
cues.zh: 數學很難，是因為它本來就難。

cues.en: Because it's hard.
cues.zh: 因為它很難。

cues.en: Because math is difficult.
cues.zh: 因為數學很困難。

cues.en: If you find it hard, that's normal.
cues.zh: 如果你覺得難，這很正常。

cues.en: That's what 99.9, 99% of people who study math experience.
cues.zh: 學數學的人，99.9，99% 都有這種經驗。

cues.en: And the difference between people who understand math and those who don't.
cues.zh: 懂數學的人，與不懂的人之間，差別是，

cues.en: Is giving up when it's hard versus embracing that difficulty as part of the learning experience.
cues.zh: 遇到困難就放棄，還是把困難視為學習過程的一部分，接納它。

cues.en: So every time you find math hard, that is a challenge for you to prove that feeling wrong.
cues.zh: 所以，每次覺得數學很難，都是一個挑戰，讓你證明那種覺得自己不行的感受是錯的。

cues.en: Now, of course, you know, it's easy for me to sit here and say this stuff, but I do speak from personal experience.
cues.zh: 當然，我坐在這裡說這些很容易，但這確實來自個人經驗。

cues.en: I do not find math easy.
cues.zh: 我不覺得數學簡單。

cues.en: It takes me a lot of time and a lot of effort to feel like I understand a concept well enough to teach it.
cues.zh: 我需要很多時間與努力，才能覺得自己對一個概念的理解，足以拿來教人。

cues.en: So my message is embrace that difficulty.
cues.zh: 所以，我想傳達的是，接納那份困難。

cues.en: That is a natural part of learning something new and it's something that almost everyone experiences, not just you.
cues.zh: 那是學新事物的自然過程，幾乎每個人都會經歷，不只有你。

cues.en: Well, if you have any comments or a reaction, feel free to post it to the Q&A for this video.
cues.zh: 如果有想法或回應，歡迎貼到這支影片的問答區。

cues.en: Otherwise move on to the next section on multi variable differentiation.
cues.zh: 否則，繼續下一節，多變數微分。

cues.en: It's a really cool section and I hope you're excited about it.
cues.zh: 那一節非常酷，希望你很期待。
